**Goal `ext-compiler`, Stage 3 (the call) is under way.** Stages 1 and 2 are on disk. The design is ADR 0246 § 8 and the goal file's § *Standing decisions*. This goal has no record slot.

`nvs run` calls an extension end to end. Codegen emits `InstKind::ExtensionCall` as a variadic call of `nvs_runtime::extension::nvs_extension_call`, with `Class::method` in slot 0 (`crates/nvs-runtime/src/extension.rs` module doc). `nvs-cli`'s `extensions::Calls` implements the seam over one `nvs_ext::call::Request`, converts runtime values to `nvs_ext::convert::Value` and back, polls the call on the calling task, raises `Failure::outcome`, and runs `Request::end` after the run (`crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs` module doc). The loader now compiles into the process's one `nvs_ext::call::Host` engine. `Value::as_array` and `Value::class_name` are the new safe readers it uses.

Both end-to-end cases pass: `tests/conformance/ext/an-extension-call-crosses-every-row-of-the-value-table.nvst` (scalars, `bytes`, list, keyed array, `?int`) and `tests/conformance/ext/an-extension-error-throws-its-class-and-a-trap-throws-extension-error.nvst`.

**Not yet crossing:** a shape. At runtime a shape value is an object of a synthesized `$shape{…}` class, so an argument crosses as `Value::Object` and is refused by `convert`, and a returned record needs the declared shape's class to build. The row-table case omits `echoItem` until it does. A returned enum, `Core` value class or resource is refused as `ExtensionError` too. A limit is a plain `FATAL` (no limit handler), and `nvs serve` installs no `Calls`.

items.text: **A shape crosses both ways**: in `crossed` (`crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs:282`) read a `$shape{…}` object's fields by name into `Crossed::Array` (add a safe field reader beside `Value::class_name` at `crates/nvs-runtime/src/value.rs:582`). For a returned shape, have the lowering pass the declared shape's codec as `json.rs`'s decode does (`InstKind::ShapeCodecConst`, `crates/nvs-codegen/src/emit.rs:666`), and build the object as `build_shape` does (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/json.rs:2690`). Then add the two `echoItem` lines back to the row-table case. `rule:packaging/a-value-crosses-as-its-wit-type`.

**The fixture's named rows**: add an enum, a closed union, a `Core` value class and a resource export to `tests/conformance/ext/fixtures/ledger/` (rebuilt and pinned by `crates/nvs-ext/tests/fixtures.rs:1`), call `kindOf` with a `mixed`, and cross each one in `runtime` (`crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs:323`). `rule:packaging/a-value-crosses-as-its-wit-type`, `rule:packaging/values-cross-as-handles`.

**A limit runs the limit handler**: map `Outcome::Fatal` to `nvs_runtime::Limit` and run `Ctx::run_limit_handler` before the `FATAL` (`crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs:240`). `rule:packaging/a-guest-crash-throws`, `rule:errors/on-limit`.

backlog: Stage 4 (qualifiers), 5 (the source section), 6 (the tools): every check in `data/goals/ext-compiler.json` under those stages.
`nvs serve` installs no `extensions::Calls` per request: `crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs` module doc.
The guest is linked with no WASI interface (standing decision 2): `crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs` `host`.
The trampoline looks the export up by name on every call: `crates/nvs-runtime/src/extension.rs` module doc.
